evidence_quotes: På oppdrag for Arbeids- og velferdsdirektoratet skal Proba undersøke hvordan samarbeidet mellom enhet med ansvar for flyktninger i kommunen og Nav fungerer.
data.reason: The text announces that Proba has been commissioned by the Norwegian Labour and Welfare Directorate to conduct a research project on the cooperation between municipal refugee units and the Norwegian Labour and Welfare Administration (NAV).
